The '''''Illorbion's Hammer''''' was a [[cathedral ship]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]], a [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Humanocentrism|anti-alien]] [[Pius Dea Crusades|crusades]] that were instigated by the [[Pius Dea]] faith that controlled the Republic. Long after the end of the Pius Dea Era, the name of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] inspired fear on the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] that the ''Illorbion's Hammer'' had previously held captive.<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Illorbion's Hammer'' was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
